content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A brand-new, more rounded chat bubble design

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement, and via TestFlight to some selected users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code that the chat bubbles in WhatsApp would be redesigned. The site's latest report indicates that the new bubble design has begun rolling out to some users on the latest TestFlight version.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

In addition to the change in the shape of the message bubble, the new design also changes the way media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more unified.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to a small number of users on the WhatsApp TestFlight version, and there is no specific timeline for when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users.
